symptom: Seven existing SB3 checkpoints were compared on the 200 mid_60_to_180 anchor_drift_sample rows, and every candidate failed the pre-training anchor alignment thresholds. The best candidate, ppo_phase_specific_anchor_smoke.zip, still had overall mean KL 2.14298 and argmax agreement 0.0.
root_cause: The selected high-KL drift rows are outside the local policy neighborhood of all existing SB3 checkpoints. Switching start checkpoints alone does not put the candidate close enough to the current-failure fallback anchor for a narrow top-200 drift-row PPO objective.
fix: Do not select an existing SB3 checkpoint solely by this sweep and continue PPO on the top-200 rows. Add a broader supervised re-alignment or distillation step, mix the drift diagnostics with full anchor data, lower PPO update pressure, and keep the anchor validation guard enabled.
validation: All sweep reports were generated by compare_sb3_to_behavior_clone_anchor.py with --include-anchor-drift-samples and thresholds max_mean_kl 0.25, min_argmax_agreement 0.85, and max_bucket_mean_kl 0.25. The summary records every candidate as failing, so no fixed-window no-regression or policy acceptance gate was attempted.
